baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening claim of superior knowledge governs the doubled listening and the listeners' concluding diagnosis.
baseline_models.mechanism: Complete disclosure to the divine knower is set against audition that operates by conjecture: partial hearing is converted into a confident claim that the man has been diverted or deceived.

activation_trace.role: Full disclosure to the knower establishes the epistemic pole against which the listeners' inference is measured.
Audition that proceeds by supposition despite failing to see supplies the listeners' incomplete inferential mode.
Speech functioning as conjecture turns incomplete reception into an asserted judgment.
Diversion and deception supply the causal label by which uncertainty is displaced onto the man.

changed_reading.before: God knows that they listen and reports the insult they utter.
changed_reading.after: The ayah exposes an epistemic asymmetry: God knows the listeners' actual process, while they convert partial audition into a conjectural causal diagnosis.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three temporal clauses move from listening, to being a secret council, to saying that only an enchanted man is followed.
baseline_models.mechanism: Auditory intake enters a closed consultation, where it is reformulated as a portable public saying. The resulting label misplaces the source of disturbance onto the messenger and diverts others from sustained following.

activation_trace.role: Perception of sound supplies the pipeline's raw intake rather than its completed understanding.
Secret consultation forms the closed social chamber in which heard material is recoded.
A saying capable of circulation turns private processing into a reputational output.
Putting a thing in the wrong place describes the transfer of the disturbance from the message's claim to the messenger's condition.
Tracing one effect after another supplies the sustained following that the circulated label is designed to interrupt.
Diversion and deception make the accusation itself an instrument for redirecting prospective followers.

changed_reading.before: Some hearers privately exchange an insult after listening.
changed_reading.after: The ayah reconstructs a social processing line: acoustic intake becomes closed counsel, then a transmissible smear that obstructs continued following.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: They repeatedly listen toward the messenger while warning others that they are merely following a man.
baseline_models.mechanism: The listeners themselves keep tracking the messenger's speech, then project that tracked relation onto believers as discreditable dependence. Calling the man enchanted lets them deny normative following while continuing adversarial pursuit.

activation_trace.role: Repeated auditory attention establishes their own continuing orientation toward the messenger.
Tracing an effect step after step makes following also resemble the listeners' own sustained tracking.
Reducing the addressee to an ordinary male supplies the flattening move in the accusation.
The charge of diversion lets hostile tracking masquerade as a warning against being diverted.

changed_reading.before: They contrast free judgment with other people's following of a compromised man.
changed_reading.after: Their accusation projects their own repeated tracking onto the followers: they remain attached as hostile auditors while redescribing receptive attachment as enchantment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence separates audible contact from understanding and acceptance. Barrier, inward covering, ear-weight, and withdrawal behave as layered filters through which listening occurs, explaining how sound can arrive while compliance is blocked.

activation_trace.role: Auditory perception supplies the contact that remains possible despite the surrounding obstructions.
Understanding and compliance supply the completion of hearing that the context shows failing.
Understanding names the missing uptake even when praise is present throughout the surrounding world.
Prevention of access supplies the outer relational barrier between recitation and audience.
A protective covering supplies the inward filter over the organ of understanding.
The ear's receptive acceptance identifies what the adjacent burden prevents, not merely a loss of sound.
Heaviness in the ear supplies the immediate sensory obstruction through which their later listening is qualified.
Physical and affective distancing gives the filtered reception its observable output.

structural_cues: 17:44 contrasts pervasive praise with failure to understand it.
17:45-46 orders barrier, heart-covering, ear-weight, and bodily withdrawal immediately before the focus listening scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive external, inward, auditory, and bodily obstructions; I infer that they specify the operative means or manner in the focus construction 'بما يستمعون به'. A live alternative is direct imposed incapacity rather than a self-reinforcing interpretive filter.

changed_reading.before: They hear the recitation but refuse its content.
changed_reading.after: They listen through a layered filter: sound reaches the ear, but covered understanding turns reception into aversion and preserves noncompliance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following instruction exposes the enchanted-man label as a struck comparison: an explanatory frame meant to classify the messenger instead produces directional loss and incapacity to reach a path.

activation_trace.role: Attributing what is not established supplies the verbal material that the next ayah inspects as a comparison.
Diversion and deception provide the compact explanatory image imposed on the messenger.
Directed perception makes the listeners' framing method itself the object of examination.
Depicting and displaying a comparison identifies their label as an active framing operation.
The struck comparison classifies the enchanted-man charge as one item in their analogical repertoire.
Departure from guidance supplies the consequence of accepting their own frame.
An extended traversable path is precisely what their explanatory comparison leaves them unable to reach.

structural_cues: The next ayah asks how they strike comparisons, echoing the focus ayah's concern with how they listen.
The explicit consequence chain is comparison, straying, then inability to find a path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus accusation and the adjacent command to inspect their comparisons; I infer that 'enchanted man' is one of those comparisons and that framing causes the path-loss. The plural may also gather accusations not stated in the focus ayah.

changed_reading.before: The phrase 'enchanted man' is a free-standing insult.
changed_reading.after: It is a failed explanatory analogy: their listening produces a frame that seems to classify the messenger but disables further orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The accusation is followed by an objection built from fragmentation, reanimation, renewed creation, and even harder imagined matter. Calling the messenger enchanted relocates the anomaly from a claim that breaks their material measure to a defect in the claimant.

activation_trace.role: Unsupported attribution supplies the defensive diagnosis assigned to the messenger.
Diversion and deception make the speaker's condition, rather than the claim's possibility, the proposed cause.
Fragmentation and debris supply the terminal material state from which the objectors cannot imagine return.
Stirring what is still out of rest supplies the denied transition from inert remains to renewed life.
Measurement and estimation supply the bounded model by which they test the possibility of a new creation.
Stone supplies a harder limiting case than bones and fragments.
Iron's resistant hardness intensifies the imagined material barrier to recreation.
Origination supplies the answering capacity that exceeds their inherited material measure.

structural_cues: 17:49 opens with another act of saying and immediately specifies the resurrection objection.
17:50-51 escalate from remains to stone and iron, then answer by invoking first origination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the accusation followed by a tightly developed material objection; I infer that the label protects the objectors' ontology by pathologizing its challenger. The alternative is that the resurrection exchange begins a separate objection with no specific causal tie to the accusation.

changed_reading.before: The enchanted-man charge is a generic attack on credibility.
changed_reading.after: It can function as an ontology-defense: a claim that exceeds familiar material measurement is neutralized by locating the abnormality in its human bearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later call reaches its proper completion in response. That sound-to-response chain exposes the focus sequence as an anti-response in which hearing terminates instead in private counsel and slander.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance define hearing's completed receptive form.
Unsupported attribution supplies the substitute output where receptive response should have occurred.
A vocal call that inclines its addressee supplies the initiating signal.
Returning speech and answering supply the fitting completion of a received call.

structural_cues: 17:52 places calling and responding in immediate verbal succession.
The focus ayah instead sequences three temporal stages from listening through counsel to hostile speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one reception chain ending in response and another ending in accusation; I infer a contrast between completed hearing and hostile processing. The eschatological call may remain a distinct scene rather than a direct gloss on present listening.

changed_reading.before: Listening is established by auditory attendance alone.
changed_reading.after: Listening is tested by its output: true reception answers the call, whereas the focus listeners replace response with a socially manufactured counter-speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The instruction to produce better speech interrupts a rival circuit in which words provoke division between people. The focus secret council is the incubator of that rival circuit, and the enchanted-man phrase is its verbal thrust.

activation_trace.role: Secret consultation supplies the closed relay in which divisive speech is coordinated.
Circulating talk allows the council's compact phrase to shape relations beyond the private exchange.
Goodness opposed to ugliness supplies the normative speech output that would interrupt the hostile relay.
Incitement that corrupts relations supplies the social effect of weaponized saying.
A thrust made with a word gives the enchanted-man label its local action within that social corruption.
The connection between parties is the relation that hostile speech damages and better speech preserves.

structural_cues: 17:53 opens with a command about what servants should say, lexically answering the wrongdoers' saying in the focus ayah.
The same ayah locates verbal provocation between human parties rather than only inside an individual hearer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed speech outputs and names word-driven interhuman incitement; I infer that the focus counsel is a production point in that circuit. The alternative is a general ethical instruction not specifically diagnosing this council.

changed_reading.before: The council merely expresses a shared private judgment.
changed_reading.after: The council is a speech relay: it converts listening into a verbal thrust that recruits division, while the command to say what is best offers the circuit-breaker.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated superior-knowledge formulas assign knowledge of audiences to God, while the messenger's guardianship over them is explicitly denied. The focus opening therefore reassures and allocates jurisdiction: hostile interior reception is known without becoming the messenger's burden to police.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower places the concealed listening process within divine knowledge.
The repeated superior-knowledge formula extends that disclosure from their listening method to the persons themselves.
Messenger and message define the entrusted communicative office without assigning control of reception.
The sufficient guardian role is explicitly negated for the messenger, delimiting his responsibility for the hostile audience.
A second repetition broadens the same knowing jurisdiction across all who occupy the heavens and earth.

structural_cues: The construction of superior knowledge with a following bi-phrase recurs in 17:47, 17:54, and 17:55.
17:54 couples that recurrence with the explicit denial that the messenger was sent as guardian over them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated knowledge formulas and a negated guardian role; I infer that the focus declaration also functions as reassurance and jurisdiction allocation. It can still function simply as an omniscience claim without this pastoral force.

changed_reading.before: The opening knowledge claim chiefly threatens the concealed listeners with exposure.
changed_reading.after: It also relieves the messenger of covert audience-management: their mode of reception is fully known by God, while his office remains transmission rather than guardianship.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the packet, increased recitational variation, a visible sign, and a displayed vision do not guarantee insight; exposure can increase aversion or transgression. The focus listening is one instance of this reverse-gain process, where more contact produces a stronger counter-frame.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance establish the receptive gain that mere repeated listening fails to deliver.
Increase supplies the paradoxical gain term whose actual output is greater distance.
Drawing away supplies the negative output generated by further exposure to the recitation.
A manifest sign supplies evidence in another sensory register whose visibility still does not force reception.
Eye-sight supplies direct visual availability as a countercase to the assumption that clearer access yields belief.
Repeated increase confirms that the response grows with exposure even when it grows in the wrong direction.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the intensified negative response to warning.
The second mapped target independently preserves the same limit-crossing image rather than collapsing the split root.

structural_cues: 17:41 and 17:60 repeat the formula in which an input increases only an adverse response.
17:59 inserts a visible sign between those recitational and visionary failures, making sensory modality insufficient across hearing and sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated exposure-to-adverse-output sequences in auditory, visible, and visionary settings; I infer a shared reverse-gain mechanism and place the focus counsel inside it. The scenes may instead be independent examples with no single reception law.

changed_reading.before: Repeated listening should at least increase informational access, even if the audience rejects it.
changed_reading.after: Exposure has negative gain: the listeners actively convert added contact into stronger distance, culminating locally in a more portable counter-description of the messenger.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the fetter is an object-sense within the hearing inventory, not the ordinary lexical sense of the repeated verb. It remains anchored by the doubled hearing root, the paired social process, and the adjacent ear-weight; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary material analogy, never as a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The hearing verb occurs twice before the listeners become a single secret council.

activation_trace.role: The paired hearing-points of a fetter cast doubled listening as a coupling that can constrain rather than open the listeners.
Secret consultation supplies the collective linkage through which the auditory constraint becomes social.
Heaviness located in the ear keeps the constraint image connected to the immediate reception sequence.

changed_reading.before: Listening is an available opening that the group fails to use.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, repeated listening can bind the hearers into a closed interpretive coupling whose weight restricts any response outside the council.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the topographic and escape branches behind the ordinary secret-counsel noun. It remains anchored in that focus root and in the preceding barrier sequence; downstream prose should qualify it as a spatial model of social withdrawal, not substitute it for the noun's direct sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The listeners become secret counsel after auditory contact and before issuing their accusation.

activation_trace.role: Escape by separation makes the council an attempted withdrawal from the address that has reached them.
Raised ground safe from inundation supplies a spatial image for the group's protected interpretive enclave.
A screening barrier supports the enclave's separation from direct encounter with the recitation.
Covering supplies the protected surface by which the council remains socially insulated.

changed_reading.before: Secret counsel is simply a low-voiced exchange hidden from others.
changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial activation, the council becomes constructed high ground: the hearers separate into an enclave meant to stay untouched, then speak from that protected position.

strongest_changes: Listening became a layered reception filter rather than a neutral acoustic act.
The enchanted-man label became both a failed analogy and a possible defense of a bounded material ontology.
Secret counsel became a speech circuit that converts heard material into circulating incitement.
The repeated knowledge formulas recast the opening as reassurance that covert reception belongs to divine knowledge, not messenger guardianship.
Call-response and reverse-gain sequences made the listeners' hostile output, rather than mere contact, the test of their hearing.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly exposes processing method: auditory, visual, and visionary contact can be filtered into distance, while the focus ayah uniquely slows that conversion into listening, closed counsel, and a portable reputational frame.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus bi-construction can still foreground what they hear, the means by which they hear, their motive, or their manner in different proportions.
The resurrection exchange may reveal the pressure behind the accusation, or it may begin a distinct objection without that causal link.
The fetter and raised-ground activations should remain imagistic outliers rather than lexical renderings.
